استعطفن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْطَفْنَ (istaʕṭafna) /is.taʕ.tˤaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# اُسْتُعْطِفْنَ (ustuʕṭifna) /us.tuʕ.tˤif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
# اِسْتَعْطِفْنَ (istaʕṭifna) /is.taʕ.tˤif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْطَفَ (istaʕṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
